body.name: Fixed-parameter algebraicity-tag algorithm
body.construction: In \(\mathsf{ArithmeticModel}\), form source-parametric circuits for the covariance Jacobian and for the same Jacobian augmented by the row of \(\lambda_e\). Use randomized source-parameter identity tests during fraction-free elimination to compare their generic ranks. If the ranks agree, return only the tag \(\mathtt{algebraic}\). If the augmented rank is larger, return exactly \((\infty,\mathcal N_{G,e})\), where \(\mathcal N_{G,e}\) consists of the rank transcript and a source-nonzero augmented minor certifying dominance of the queried-coordinate projection. This unconditional construction does not return \(d_e(G)\), \(p_e\), \(\mathcal Q_{G,e}\), or \(h_{G,e}\) on the algebraic branch.
